subject.title: improve(imessage): manage imsg setup and plugin skill ownership

question: Should imsg become available only through the activated iMessage plugin, with doctor repairing stale snapshots only when the generated plugin-skill target exists?
rationale: This is an upgrade-visible skill publication and session-state policy choice; the code can be repaired mechanically, but automation cannot decide whether existing always-visible imsg skill compatibility should be preserved.

options.title: Accept plugin-scoped imsg ownership
options.body: After the boundary-check fix, merge the PR as the channel-plugin ownership model and accept that users must activate iMessage before the imsg skill is published.

options.title: Preserve always-available imsg compatibility
options.body: Require a compatibility path so upgraded agents can still resolve imsg skill metadata before iMessage activation, with focused upgrade coverage.

options.title: Split setup from skill relocation
options.body: Land the Homebrew setup/docs improvements separately and defer the skill ownership move until the plugin-skill policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept plugin-scoped imsg ownership
recommendation.body: After the boundary-check fix, merge the PR as the channel-plugin ownership model and accept that users must activate iMessage before the imsg skill is published.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md names tyler6204 for iMessage/macOS, and the unresolved choice is specific to that plugin boundary and upgrade behavior.
